question: Which component of Windows OS allows users to modify system settings such as display resolution, sound preferences and user accounts?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Control Panel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Control Panel** is a fundamental component of the **Windows Operating System** that allows users to modify various **system settings**.
 
• It provides a centralized interface to manage settings such as **display resolution, sound preferences, user accounts, network configurations, and more.**
